title: Man With Expired License And No Insurance Causes Awful Accident And Flees The Scene
description:
#news #police #arrest

On May 5th, 2022. Officers responded to the scene of a nasty car crash in which a lady needed urgent transport to the hospital. It was said that a man ran a red light and collided into the oncoming vehicle. The man was completely at fault. When the accident happened the man immediately got into a random passengers car and took off. He later returned to the scene and said he wanted to get his mom. The man was identified as “Richard”.
